title: Repair that reopens the decision that caused it

method.plan: critic observations (B-05a dimensions + B-05b adversarial) grouped by scope; the origin layer is the critics' weighted vote, refined where the plan can confirm it, then the failure taxonomy's owning layers; each group becomes one bounded operation on that layer's plan objects (repairPlanner.ts)
method.execute: the operation edits the named layer's plan object and every layer below it is re-derived (arc -> section plan -> budget -> transitions -> part plan); only the tasks in scope are recomposed and spliced over the candidate's notes (repairExecutor.ts)
method.accept: the pass is kept only if every targeted observation is gone, the judge's burden and blocking count did not rise, no note outside the pass's windows changed (notesOutsideScopePreserved) and no planned family was silenced; otherwise it is reverted and recorded as tried/rejected with the reason (criticRepairLoop.ts runBacktrackingRepairLoop)
method.noOp: a pass that changed neither the plan nor the notes is rejected before it spends a pass and can never be reported as a repair (R-1a P1-4)
method.passes: default 3, at most 5; the queue is deeper than the budget and is dealt round-robin over operation shape so the budget covers distinct problems

corpus.gate: the DAG asks for >= 80 % repaired at the originating layer; the measured number is reported instead, with the reason per defect
